newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI can fall further, says Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI can fall further, says Rato.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday the inflation rate can fall further thanks to a possible decline in prices in the service sector.
"Overall the inflation trend is good, 1997 wage negotiations are doing fine and Spain's economy is absorbing the dollar's rise," Rato said in a radio interview.
"The service sector will allow a new drop in the inflation rate" he added. The government also intends to contribute to lower prices through liberalisation, the minister said.
Spanish inflation fell to 2.5 percent year-on-year in February from 2.9 percent in January, while inflation in the service sector was 3.4 percent in February versus 3.5 percent the previous month.
